description: The Qanat Community repository contains a published release of the Groundwater Accounting Platform developed by California water-data organisations. It tracks wells and meters, usage, allocations, field or parcel management and groundwater policy, helping users assemble an accounting baseline for aquifer planning. Inputs are local groundwater records and management rules; outputs are account and allocation views for the selected basin and period. Geographic coverage is a participating basin, with California SGMA as the stated design context. The repository describes AGPL-3.0 terms and offers the last published source release. It says current source is available on request, not in this repository. A limitation is that this system is accounting software, not a groundwater-flow solver, and a new deployment needs validated records and current-code access. It can prepare management constraints for aquifer simulations. The related catalogue Costa Rica monitoring network is a distinct observation source. No user account, well data or source archive was obtained.
name: Qanat groundwater accounting platform
notes: G7 G7-1576. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
